# raff_database_plans (Data Source)

Managed database plans with pricing. Use a plan `id` as `plan_id` on `raff_database`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `engine` (String) Only plans of this engine.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `plans` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `engine` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `is_free_tier` (Boolean)
- `max_connections` (Number)
- `memory_gib` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `price_per_hour` (Number)
- `price_per_month` (Number)
- `storage_gib` (Number)
- `vcpu` (Number)
